t: Jupyter Notebooks in VSCode and Cursor AI
s: This article details how to enable AI-assisted Jupyter Notebook execution within VSCode and Cursor by ensuring a pre-running Jupyter kernel is available, particularly focusing on a NixOS environment using Pipulate and Nix Flakes.
